messages:
Samir Khan: quick UX flag — the 'Token created' toast pops top-right then fades. Screen readers don't pick up toasts reliably. We should ensure the creation flow makes the secret copy step discoverable and announced. Anya Park: +1, I missed the token on first try. Users need a clear, copy-first affordance. Maybe a persistent modal/drawer after create? :thinking_face: Jess Li: agreed. Proposal: show a modal with the token and a prominent Copy button, AND add an aria-live announcement. Example:
New token created
. Also add aria-describedby on the copy CTA for extra context. Samir Khan: can we avoid relying on toasts alone? Some SRs ignore brief toasts. Modal + aria-live seems safer. DesignBot: mock v1 uploaded -> https://redwood.design/tmp/token-create-modal.png :eyes: Anya Park: tiny UI nit — CTA order should be 'Copy secret' then 'Done'. Copy is the primary action. Ellie M.: permissions note: show a small line: 'Scope: read-only' under the token name. Users ask about who can use it. Keep it low-ink. Jess Li: accessibility nit: on modal open, move focus to the token field and select-all. Example snippet: ``` ``` This helps keyboard + SR users copy quickly. Samir Khan: also, 4s toast duration is too short. If we keep a toast, make it longer (12s) or persistent until dismissed. Anya Park: and when Copy is pressed, announce 'Copied to clipboard' via aria-live polite. Jess Li: edge case: if user navigates away before copying, we should offer a 'Download .env' link or a reminder modal. Also think about making the modal non-blocking but persistent until dismissed. Samir Khan: wording: current "This is the only time we will show this token" reads a bit harsh. Suggest: "We won't display the token again after you leave this screen. Please copy or download it now." Softer but still clear. Ellie M.: can we add an expandable inline permission matrix link: 'Who can use this token' -> expands to show roles? UX wants cheap clarity without leaving flow. DesignBot: updated mock v2 -> https://redwood.design/tmp/token-create-modal-v2.png (added permission toggle, focus trap notes) Product-Bot: reminder: add to spec doc -> /docs/product/token-create-a11y.md Samir Khan: action items: Jess to add aria patterns + clipboard announcement, Anya to update microcopy, Design to finalise modal layout and CTA order, PM to add spec link and note on default scopes. I'll track in the PR. Jess Li: I'll drop the aria + focus code in #eng before EOD. Anya Park: I'll push microcopy suggestions and the permission blurb. DesignBot: adding keyboard flow and focus-trap notes to the mock file. Samir Khan: thanks all :thumbsup:
